meta.title: FaultLens — Find the root cause in minutes

hero.lead: FaultLens streams Kubernetes, Docker, SSH and CI/CD logs into one feed, groups identical errors, links them to deploys and suggests the root cause.
hero.mockCause: v2.14.0 cut the connection pool from 50 to 10. Restore HIKARI_MAX_POOL=50.

features.title: See the signal, not the noise.

grouping.title: Smart grouping
grouping.body: Thousands of lines with the same stack trace collapse into one group; multi-line events are joined.

deploy.title: Deploy correlation
deploy.body: See which version started each error group, so rollback calls are obvious.

rca.title: Root-cause analysis
rca.body: Rule-based engine or AI, with a confidence score and a concrete fix.

alerts.title: Flexible alerts
alerts.body: Threshold, regex pattern or new group, with cooldowns to keep it quiet.

notify.title: Notify anywhere
notify.body: In-app, Slack, email, signed webhooks, browser and mobile.

rbac.title: Role-based access
rbac.body: ADMIN, EDITOR, VIEWER: clear on who can change what.

connect.title: Connect a source
connect.body: A Kubernetes namespace, a Docker container or an SSH file path.

watch.title: Group and watch
watch.body: Logs stream live, errors are grouped and the dashboard builds an hourly heatmap.

analyze.title: Analyze and notify
analyze.body: A rule fires an alert; the root cause and fix reach your team.

security.title: Your logs, your data.
security.body: FaultLens runs on your infrastructure. AI analysis is optional and only sends data with your explicit consent.

sessions.title: Short-lived sessions
sessions.body: Access tokens last 15 min and live in memory only; the refresh token rotates in an HttpOnly cookie.

secrets.title: Encrypted secrets
secrets.body: SSH keys, Slack and webhook URLs are stored encrypted and never shown again.

rbac.title: Role-based access
rbac.body: Deletion and system settings are ADMIN-only; every destructive action asks first.

retention.title: Retention control
retention.body: From 7 to 120 days or forever; old logs are deleted nightly.

cta.title: Be ready for the next incident.
cta.body: Connect your first source and see your first error group in minutes.
